column1: # ISCC-NBS colour-name blocks: number, name, central (centroid) Munsell notation, open.
# Source: K. L. Kelly, "Central Notations for the Revised ISCC-NBS Color-name Blocks",
# J. Res. NBS 61(5), 1958, RP2911, Table 1. Public domain (US federal government work).
# Text from the Wikisource transcription of that paper; its OCR errors were corrected
# against an independent transcription (R package munsellinterpol, CentroidsISCCNBS),
# with which every row then agrees. open = Kelly marks the chroma "+": the block is
# open-ended in chroma, so the notation is a lower bound, not a centre.
